vectors.name: agent_1_0
vectors.rationale: Hold i_rstn=0 for two cycles to satisfy the contract reset, then stream valid A5, 3C, C3 so C3 is in stage1 when flush asserts. Flush during in-flight must drop C3 and output zeros; after deassert, no stale data may reappear.

vectors.name: agent_2_1
vectors.rationale: Release reset, drive i_valid=1 with A5. First accepted word schedules emission one edge later.

vectors.name: agent_3_2
vectors.rationale: Back-to-back valid with new value 3C; previous A5 should appear on o_data this edge, exercising two-stage delay.

vectors.name: agent_4_3
vectors.rationale: Third consecutive valid word C3; 3C appears on output. C3 is now in stage1 awaiting an edge, so it is the in-flight word that flush must discard.

vectors.name: agent_5_4
vectors.rationale: Assert i_flush=1 while C3 is in stage1 and i_valid=1 simultaneously. Flush must take precedence over the valid input and clear both stages and current outputs on this same edge.

vectors.name: agent_6_5
vectors.rationale: Deassert flush with valid=0 to confirm the dropped C3 and the simultaneously-presented 7E never reappear; outputs stay zero.

vectors.name: agent_7_6
vectors.rationale: After flush, accept boundary data 00 as a new word to verify pipeline restarts from a truly empty state.

vectors.name: agent_8_7
vectors.rationale: The accepted 00 should emit this edge with o_valid=1 and o_data=00, distinguishing a valid zero word from the invalid-zero output.

vectors.name: agent_9_8
vectors.rationale: Accept boundary data FF as the next word after the zero word was delivered; exercises all-ones data path.

vectors.name: agent_10_9
vectors.rationale: FF should appear on o_data with o_valid=1; set valid=0 so the following edge produces an invalid zero output, exercising the valid-then-empty boundary.

vectors.name: agent_11_10
vectors.rationale: Final empty cycle to observe o_valid=0 and o_data=00 after the FF word has drained, confirming invalid outputs are zeroed.

vectors.name: agent_1_0
vectors.rationale: First accept of 0xFF after reset; check DUT accepts boundary data and fills stage 1.

vectors.name: agent_2_1
vectors.rationale: Back-to-back accept of 0x00 keeps pipeline full; E1 should emit 0xFF while capturing 0x00.

vectors.name: agent_3_2
vectors.rationale: Flush while a valid input is offered: synchronous flush must take precedence, clear both stages and outputs, and drop the input.

vectors.name: agent_4_3
vectors.rationale: First cycle after flush with no input; previously flushed data must not reappear.

vectors.name: agent_5_4
vectors.rationale: Second post-flush empty cycle confirms no in-flight data resurfaces late.

vectors.name: agent_6_5
vectors.rationale: After flush, accepting 0x55 must restart pipeline cleanly from empty state.

vectors.name: agent_7_6
vectors.rationale: Second back-to-back accept 0x3C after flush; E1 should emit 0x55.

vectors.name: agent_8_7
vectors.rationale: Empty slot following the two re-accepts to check alternating valid/empty ordering.

vectors.name: agent_9_8
vectors.rationale: Drain remaining in-flight data; invalid output cycle must carry zero data.

vectors.name: agent_10_9
vectors.rationale: Accept mixed-bit pattern 0x81 to cover non-boundary byte values.

vectors.name: agent_11_10
vectors.rationale: One-cycle latency check that 0x81 is emitted with o_valid=1.

vectors.name: agent_12_11
vectors.rationale: Final empty cycle: o_valid must be 0 and o_data fixed to 0x00.

vectors.name: agent_1_0
vectors.rationale: E0 accepts 0xA5; output after this edge should be empty.

vectors.name: agent_2_1
vectors.rationale: E1 accepts 0x3C while emitting 0xA5; checks back-to-back valid throughput.

vectors.name: agent_3_2
vectors.rationale: E2 emits 0x3C while accepting an empty cycle; checks o_data stays from same input beat.

vectors.name: agent_4_3

vectors.name: agent_5_4
vectors.rationale: E3 empty cycle with reset released; pipeline should be drained and o_valid=0.

vectors.name: agent_6_5
vectors.rationale: E4 flush=1 and i_valid=1; flush takes precedence, output zero and input 0x7E dropped.

vectors.name: agent_7_6
vectors.rationale: E5 after flush; no old data should reappear, o_valid=0.

vectors.name: agent_8_7
vectors.rationale: E6 accepts 0xFF after flush; checks pipeline restart from empty state.

vectors.name: agent_9_8
vectors.rationale: E7 emits 0xFF from E6; checks boundary data 0xFF and mixed validity sequence.
